name: to
label: To
help: The destination fax number in E.164, for example +12025550123. With a test key, +15550000001 is delivered, +15550000003 is partial and +15550000005 is unknown.

nested.name: text
nested.label: Text
nested.help: Plain text rendered to a letter PDF.

nested.name: markdown
nested.label: Markdown
nested.help: Markdown (headings, lists, emphasis, code) rendered to PDF.

name: filename
label: Filename
help: A name for the document, shown in the dashboard.

name: coverSubject
label: Cover sheet subject
help: Any cover field adds a billable cover page in front of the document.

name: approvalId
label: Approval ID
help: An approved request bound to this send (apr_...), when the account needs a human approval for live sends. A person grants it in the dashboard.

name: clientReference
label: Client reference
help: Your own reference stored on the fax, up to 200 characters.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency key
help: Repeating a send with the same key returns the same fax instead of a second one. Empty means make: followed by the quote id.
